objective: build the 10,447,765-row source-hash-bound sAlex membership index while performing WBM overlap checks in the same complete source stream

one_pass_design.salex_aselmdb_shards: one temporary shard at a time
one_pass_design.overlap_observer: receives the same materialized ASE Atoms before each membership row is yielded
one_pass_design.wbm_targets: memory-bounded SQLite target index built from the frozen WBM initial-structure JSONL

pilot.purpose: estimate end-to-end prototype/fingerprint throughput including first-shard network and extraction overhead
pilot.estimate_scope: lower-bound sAlex network/extraction + fingerprint + prototype throughput; excludes WBM target-index build, SQLite membership writes, and candidate StructureMatcher comparisons

requires: exact Rhombus commit checkout verified inside Kaggle
frozen Matbench prototype source checkout and blob identity verified
frozen WBM source SHA256 and row count verified
complete sAlex source SHA256 and 10,447,765 row count verified
output artifact hashes and row counts validated before evidence promotion
full_run_gate.decision_basis: 4.896 h naive lower-bound is too close to the 6 h GitHub Actions hard stop before SQLite writes, WBM target-index construction, StructureMatcher comparisons, compression, and artifact handling
